# Plus and minus

<!-- STEP id="two-ways" -->
On a straight line, an object can go only two ways. Positions to the right of O are positive (+). Positions to the left of O are negative (-).

<!-- STEP id="points" -->
Point A is at +80 m: 80 m to the right of O. Point P is at -20 m: 20 m to the left of O. The sign gives the direction.
